modules.name: Chart of accounts and account mapping
Ledger reports and the report designer

cases.title: A posting dated on or before the lock date is refused for every document type
cases.given: A lock date of the last day of last month is set
cases.when: An invoice, expense, receipt, vendor payment, bank adjustment and manual journal are each dated on the lock date
cases.then: Every one is refused with the lock-date message and nothing is written (no voucher, no ledger line)

cases.title: A posting the day after the lock date is accepted
cases.when: An invoice is dated lock date + 1 day
cases.then: It posts normally

cases.title: Cancelling an old document posts on the cancellation date and is also guarded
cases.given: An invoice from a locked period exists
cases.when: It is cancelled with a reversal date inside the locked period
cases.then: The cancellation is refused; with an open reversal date it succeeds

cases.title: Only the override-lock permission lets a posting through the lock date, and it is audited
cases.given: A user holds postingControl.overrideLock, another does not
cases.when: Both post into the locked period
cases.then: The first posts and an audit entry names it; the second is refused

cases.title: Back-date window: today passes, N days back passes, N+1 days back is refused
cases.when: Documents are dated today, today-7, today-8
cases.then: The first two post; the third is refused

cases.title: A holder of the back-date permission may go past the window and an audit entry is written
cases.when: The user posts a document dated 30 days back
cases.then: It posts; the audit log has BACKDATED_POSTING with the reason

cases.title: A reason is required once an entry is older than the reason threshold
cases.when: A document dated 5 days back is posted without a reason, then with one
cases.then: The first is refused; the second posts and keeps the reason on the document and in the audit log

cases.title: The rules judge the posting date, not the document date
cases.when: A document is dated 30 days back but its posting date is today
cases.then: It posts (the ledger date is within the window)

cases.title: The same rules apply to expenses, payments and journals, not only invoices
cases.given: A lock date and a window are set
cases.when: An expense, a payment and a manual journal are dated outside them
cases.then: All three are refused

cases.title: No policy means no restriction beyond the open fiscal month
cases.given: A company has never set a policy
cases.when: Documents are dated anywhere in an open month
cases.then: They post

cases.title: The policy can be read by everyone but changed only with its own permission
cases.given: A read-only user and an editor exist
cases.when: Both try to save a new policy
cases.then: Only the editor succeeds; invalid values (negative days, bad date) are refused for both

cases.title: A closed fiscal month refuses every posting dated in it; reopening allows them
cases.when: An invoice, receipt and journal dated in October are posted; October is then reopened and they are posted again
cases.then: Refused while closed, accepted when open

cases.title: A filed VAT quarter refuses VAT-touching postings but accepts others
cases.when: A VAT invoice and a non-VAT journal are dated in Q3
cases.then: The invoice is refused; the journal posts

cases.title: A frozen (not yet filed) VAT quarter refuses VAT journals
cases.when: A manual journal touching a VAT account is dated in Q3
cases.then: It is refused at submit and at approval

cases.title: The Posting Control screen shows the current rules and saves changes
cases.given: A user with postingControl.update opens the screen
cases.when: They set a lock date and save
cases.then: The new date shows after reload and the next posting obeys it

cases.title: The Posting Control screen is read-only for a user without update permission
cases.then: Fields are disabled and no Save button is offered

cases.title: A policy change in company A never affects company B
cases.then: B can still post in that period

cases.title: The bank-reconciliation fee entry obeys the lock date and the back-date window
cases.given: A lock date after the statement date
cases.when: A bank charge is posted from a reconciliation dated before the lock
cases.then: It is refused

cases.title: A receipt or vendor payment dated in a locked period is refused
cases.when: A receipt and a payment are dated inside it
cases.then: Both are refused

cases.title: A document with only a document date gets the same posting date
cases.given: An invoice is created with docDate only
cases.then: posting_date equals doc_date

cases.title: A document posted into a later period keeps its own document date
cases.then: Operational reports place it on 5 Oct; financial statements on 2 Nov

cases.title: Operational reports (sales register, customer statement) use the document date
cases.given: Invoices with different doc and posting dates
cases.when: The sales register is run for October
cases.then: Rows are selected by doc_date

cases.title: Financial statements (trial balance, balance sheet, VAT) use the posting date
cases.when: The trial balance is run for October
cases.then: Amounts are selected by posting_date

cases.title: The API no longer accepts the retired date field
cases.given: A client sends {date: ...} to create an invoice or expense
cases.then: The retired field is ignored or refused; docDate is required

cases.title: An invalid date string is refused on every dated endpoint
cases.given: Documents are posted with 2026-13-45, empty, and non-date text
cases.then: A clear 400 message; nothing is written

cases.title: Created-by and created-at are stamped on every document and a later edit stamps updated-by / updated-at
cases.given: A document is created then edited by another user
cases.then: created_* belongs to the first user, updated_* to the second

cases.title: A document entered just before and just after midnight keeps the date the user chose
cases.given: A document is dated today at 23:59 and at 00:01 local time
cases.then: Each keeps its chosen date (no timezone shift)

cases.title: Every renamed date column exists once in the live schema and no old name remains
cases.when: information_schema is queried for date / posting_date columns
cases.then: Names follow docs/date-fields-standard.md; no table still has a plain "date" column

cases.title: Date columns are Postgres date, not timestamp, for business dates
cases.then: doc_date, posting_date and the <meaning>_date columns are of type date

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A new company gets the standard chart with every posting role mapped once and an account for its bank
cases.then: The Saudi starter chart exists, 16 posting roles are mapped once, the bank has its own account

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Company A never sees company B accounts
cases.then: Only B accounts appear

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A read-only role can list but not create, edit, deactivate, import, export or map
cases.then: Each write is refused with 403

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A user with no ledger keys is refused the account list
cases.given: A user with no chart permission

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Create an account under a heading
cases.when: A new account is created under it
cases.then: It saves with the next level and the parent total includes it

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Duplicate account code is refused
cases.then: 400 duplicate code

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A parent of a different type or a non-heading parent is refused
cases.when: A revenue account is created under it
cases.then: Refused

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Tree depth: four levels are accepted, a fifth is refused
cases.given: A chart with four nested headings
cases.then: The limit message is shown

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A parent cannot become its own descendant (loop)
cases.when: The heading is re-parented under its own child
cases.then: Refused

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: An account with postings cannot change type
cases.then: Refused; name and code may still change

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A control account can be renamed but not retyped or deactivated
cases.then: Refused

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: An account with a balance cannot be deactivated; a zero-balance one can, and can be reactivated
cases.given: Two accounts, one with a balance
cases.then: Only the zero-balance one succeeds

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A heading with active children cannot be deactivated
cases.then: Refused

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Pointing a posting role at another account is not retroactive
cases.when: The role is mapped to account Y
cases.then: Old lines stay on X, new ones go to Y

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A bank line posts to the bank own account
cases.when: A receipt is posted to each
cases.then: Each line is on its own bank account

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: The database refuses a line that points at another company account
cases.when: An insert links a line of A to an account of B
cases.then: The composite foreign key rejects it

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Expense categories start on a default account and can be re-pointed to an Expense account only
cases.when: It is mapped to a revenue account, then to an expense account
cases.then: Refused, then accepted

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Excel import previews first and saves only the chosen rows, never changing a type
cases.when: It is previewed, 2 of 5 rows are selected and saved
cases.then: Only those 2 are created; existing types are untouched

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: A file with the wrong columns is refused; a reader may neither import nor export
cases.given: A wrong file; a read-only user
cases.then: Refused

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: An ordinary account becomes a customer or vendor control account only if it fits and has no postings
cases.when: It is made a customer control account; then one with postings
cases.then: The first succeeds, the second is refused

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Arabic account names show on Arabic documents and the chart
cases.given: An account with an Arabic name
cases.then: The Arabic name is shown

cases.module: Chart of accounts and account mapping
cases.title: Expense accounts picked in a bank reconciliation exclude headings, control and inactive accounts
cases.when: The adjustment account list is read
cases.then: Only active, postable expense and revenue accounts are offered

cases.title: A draft saves with a number and refuses control, bank, heading, inactive, foreign and malformed lines
cases.when: A draft is saved with each bad line
cases.then: Each is refused with a line-specific message

cases.title: A user without journals.create cannot draft
A draft can be edited (lines replaced) only with the update key
cases.when: It is edited with and without the key
cases.then: Allowed / 403

cases.title: An unbalanced journal cannot be submitted
cases.then: Refused with the difference shown

cases.title: A line with both debit and credit, or neither, is refused
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: Negative and absurdly large amounts are refused
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: Submit moves the draft to pending and locks it from editing
cases.then: Edit refused

cases.title: Approval by someone else posts it to the ledger exactly once
cases.when: A different approver approves, then approves again
cases.then: One ledger entry; the second approval is refused

cases.title: Two approvers approve at the same moment: one entry only
cases.when: Two approve requests run in parallel
cases.then: One succeeds, one is refused, one ledger entry exists

cases.title: The preparer cannot approve their own journal unless the owner allows self-approval
cases.then: Refused; after the owner enables it, allowed and flagged self-approved

cases.title: Only the owner / admin may change the self-approval setting
Rejection needs a reason and returns the journal to the preparer
cases.when: Reject without, then with a reason
cases.then: Refused, then rejected; the preparer can fix and resubmit

cases.title: A month closed after submission blocks approval
cases.given: A pending journal dated in an open month
cases.when: The month is closed, then the journal is approved
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: Discarding a draft keeps its number on record; a posted journal cannot be discarded
cases.given: A draft and a posted journal
cases.then: First succeeds (number kept), second refused

cases.title: Reversal creates a reversing draft that itself needs approval and posts the mirror once
cases.then: Mirror posted; second reversal refused

cases.title: A discarded reversal frees the original to be reversed again
cases.then: The original can be reversed again

cases.title: A document-made entry has no manual journal to reverse
cases.when: Reverse is attempted from the journal screen
cases.then: Refused with a pointer to the document

cases.title: The journal list filters by status, date and text and pages
cases.then: Correct subsets and totals

cases.title: A posted entry shows its accounts and is invisible to another company
A back-dated journal beyond the reason threshold needs a reason that is kept
cases.when: A journal dated 10 days back is submitted
cases.then: Reason required; stored on the journal

cases.title: Journal numbers are unique per company and never reused
cases.then: Numbers keep increasing; a discarded number is not reused

cases.title: Row-level security hides other companies manual journals even without a WHERE clause
cases.when: The tenant role selects all journals
cases.then: Only its own rows

cases.title: Journal voucher print data exists for a manual journal and the entry it posted
cases.then: Same number, lines and totals; another company gets 404

cases.title: The journal form keeps typed data when a validation error is shown
cases.then: All lines remain on screen with the error beside line 3

cases.title: Eligible accounts exclude control accounts but include banks with their own opening figure
cases.then: Control accounts are absent; each bank shows its opening balance

cases.title: A preview does not save and refuses control, P&L, heading and foreign accounts
cases.then: Errors listed; nothing saved

cases.title: An unbalanced sheet cannot be posted until the difference goes to an Equity account
cases.then: Refused; accepted when the equity plug line is added

cases.title: Opening posts once, needs the post key and a confirmation
cases.when: Post without key / without confirmation / twice
cases.then: Each wrong attempt refused; second live run refused

cases.title: A wrong opening entry can be reversed with a reason and a corrected one accepted
cases.then: Both succeed

cases.title: The opening balance sheet figure flows into the first period reports
cases.when: Balance sheet is run at the opening date
cases.then: Totals equal the opening sheet and balance

cases.title: Branch and Department are seeded for every company and offered to pickers
cases.then: Branch and Department exist

cases.title: Custom dimensions can be added; duplicates are refused
cases.then: Second refused

cases.title: Seeded dimensions can never be removed or re-sourced
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: A value tree refuses loops, foreign parents and non-hierarchical nesting
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: Cost centres have an optional home branch, hierarchy and the same guards
cases.then: Hierarchy and home branch work; loops refused

cases.title: A rule on one account sets optional / required / not allowed with an optional default
cases.when: A Required Department rule is set
cases.then: Saved; headings and foreign accounts refused

cases.title: A rule applies to a type, heading, range or list with a preview first
cases.when: Bulk rule is previewed then applied
cases.then: Preview count equals applied count

cases.title: A Required tag missing blocks submit but not draft save
cases.when: Draft saved; submit attempted; tag added; submit
cases.then: Draft ok; submit refused; then accepted and posted once

cases.title: A tag the account does not allow, an unknown, foreign or inactive value is refused
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: Equal tags on several lines share one combination
cases.given: A journal with two lines tagged equally
cases.then: One dimension combination row

cases.title: A reversal carries the original tags; an account default fills a missing tag
cases.then: Mirror lines keep tags

cases.title: Documents apply defaults but never block on a Required rule
cases.given: An invoice for an account with a Required rule
cases.then: It posts; defaults fill; no blocking

cases.title: The database refuses a dimension entry pointing at another company value
cases.then: Composite FK rejects

cases.title: Branch-restricted user only sees entries of their own branches in ledger reads
cases.given: A user restricted to branch X
cases.when: General ledger and journals are read
cases.then: Only branch X entries (entries with no branch are hidden)

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Every company has the five standard reports as editable defaults; another company sees none of them
cases.then: Trial Balance, Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Changes in Equity exist

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Income Statement: revenue positive, subtotals and formulas follow, comparatives and variance tie
cases.given: Revenue and expenses posted in two periods
cases.then: Net profit and variance columns reconcile

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Balance Sheet balances, carries profit to date in equity, compares with the prior year end
cases.then: Assets = liabilities + equity

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Trial Balance balances in opening, movement and closing, in Summary and Detailed mode
cases.then: Debit totals equal credit totals in each column

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: A viewer needs the report own permission; designer permissions do not give it

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Cash Flow (indirect) explains the change in cash and agrees with bank and cash accounts
cases.then: Net change equals the bank account change

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Changes in Equity: opening + profit + movements = closing equity
cases.then: Closing equals balance sheet equity

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: A row can pin to the opening balance; the Cash selector finds every bank account
cases.when: Design a row with the Cash selector
cases.then: All bank accounts included once

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Copy a standard report, edit it; only a designer can
cases.then: Only the designer succeeds

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Account selection by range, rollup, type and role, include and exclude; double counting refused
cases.given: A design counting an account twice
cases.then: Refused

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Every balance display rule, subtotal, formula, hidden and non-zero row works
cases.then: Each rule shows as specified

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Every column option: debit / credit / opening / closing, Dr/Cr pairs, ranges, variance columns
cases.then: Values per option are correct

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Dimension filters on columns give a branch comparison; on the run they narrow the report
cases.then: Totals match the filtered ledger

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Accounts no row covers are listed with a warning count
cases.then: Warning lists the uncovered accounts

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Malformed formatting is refused; default can be set; deactivate and reset work
cases.then: Refused

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Every figure drills down to the accounts and the General Ledger reproduces it
cases.then: The ledger lines sum to the figure

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Excel export carries bold, double underline, shading and number formats
cases.then: The workbook has the formatting

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: General Ledger: opening, movements, running balance and closing add up
cases.given: Postings in and before the period
cases.then: Opening + movements = closing; running balance ends at closing

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Ledger vs Documents separates manual journals from document postings and agrees to the cent
cases.then: Every account pair agrees; manual entries are listed apart

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Money held on account is compared like with like in Ledger vs Documents
cases.then: AR agrees after netting customer advances

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: The consistency check passes all error-level rules after a day of mixed activity
cases.given: Invoices, receipts, payments, journals, bank reconciliation
cases.then: No error-level failure

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: A report over 100000 ledger lines returns within the agreed time
cases.when: Trial balance and general ledger are run
cases.then: Under 5 seconds each

cases.module: Ledger reports and the report designer
cases.title: Branch-restricted users see branch totals only and are told so
cases.then: Figures cover their branches; the notice is shown

cases.title: A document with no matching rule posts directly
cases.given: A company with no approval rules
cases.when: A vendor payment and a vendor bill are created
cases.then: Both post immediately, exactly as before

cases.title: A payment inside a rule band enters Pending Approval and posts nothing
cases.given: A rule: payments above 5000 need one approval
cases.then: No voucher, no ledger entry, no bank movement; the document is Pending Approval

cases.title: Amount band boundaries: exactly at the threshold and just above it
cases.then: The first follows the rule defined for its band, the second the next band, with no gap or overlap

cases.title: A two-level chain needs both approvals in order
cases.given: A rule with level 1 (accountant role) and level 2 (finance manager)
cases.when: Level 2 tries first, then level 1 approves, then level 2
cases.then: Level 2 first is refused; after level 1 then level 2 the payment posts once

cases.title: The submitter cannot approve while self-approval is off
cases.when: The submitter approves their own payment, bill, credit note and journal
cases.then: Each is refused server-side at every level

cases.title: With self-approval on the submitter may approve and the document is flagged
cases.given: The company setting is on (changed by the owner, audited)
cases.when: The submitter approves their own payment
cases.then: It posts; flagged self-approved; the audit log shows the setting change and the use

cases.title: Only owner/admin may change the self-approval setting
cases.given: A finance manager without admin rights
cases.then: 403; the setting is unchanged

cases.title: A manager of the submitter can be the approver
cases.given: A user with a manager; a level naming manager of the submitter
cases.when: The submitter submits; the manager approves
cases.then: Only that manager (or a valid delegate) may approve

cases.title: Rejection returns the document to draft with remarks and nothing posts
cases.when: An approver rejects without, then with remarks
cases.then: Refused without remarks; with remarks the document is Draft and the history shows them

cases.title: The submitter can recall a pending request; nobody else can; nothing was posted; a corrected one can be resubmitted
cases.when: Another user tries to recall it, then the submitter recalls it, then it is decided or recalled again, then a new one is submitted
cases.then: Others are refused; the request is Recalled with the history kept; it can no longer be decided; a fresh request is accepted

cases.title: A delegate with a valid period may decide; outside it may not
cases.given: A delegation from an approver to a deputy with a validity period
cases.when: The deputy decides before the period, after it, after it was ended, and inside it
cases.then: Refused before, after and when ended; allowed inside; the history names who they acted for; another company sees no delegations

cases.title: The posting guard is re-checked at final approval and tenant isolation holds
cases.given: A pending payment dated before a lock date set after submission; two companies
cases.when: The last level approves; company B calls company A requests
cases.then: Posting is refused by the guard; company B gets 404 and sees none of the rules or requests

cases.title: A vendor bill follows the same rules: above the band it waits and creates nothing, the last approval creates it once
cases.given: A rule for vendor bills above 500
cases.when: A bill of 100 and a bill of 1150 are submitted; the submitter and then the level holder try to approve
cases.then: The small bill posts; the large one waits (no bill, GRN unbilled); the submitter is refused; the approver creates the bill and the GRN is billed

cases.title: The "paid at delivery" shortcut cannot bypass an approval rule
cases.given: A rule for vendor bills above 500
cases.when: A goods receipt of 1150 is saved with auto-post-bill-and-pay; then with no rule
cases.then: It is refused whole (no receipt kept) with the rule named; with no rule it is allowed

cases.title: A user's manager must be a user of the same company, never themselves, and the chain cannot loop
cases.when: A user is saved with a manager of another company, with themselves, and with someone who already reports to them
cases.then: Each is refused with a message; a valid same-company manager is saved

cases.title: A credit note follows the same rules: above the band it waits and issues nothing; the last approval issues it once, created by the submitter
cases.given: A rule for credit notes above 500
cases.when: A credit note of 115 and one of 1150 are requested; the submitter and then the level holder try to approve
cases.then: The small one is issued; the large one waits (no note); the submitter is refused; the approver issues it with the submitter as creator; a second credit note against the same invoice is refused

cases.title: A manual journal above the band needs every level and posts once at the last; rejection returns it to the preparer; below the band the single maker-checker step is unchanged
cases.given: A two-level rule for journals above 100; a preparer without the posting right
cases.when: A journal of 300 is submitted and decided out of order and in order; one of 400 is rejected; one of 50 is submitted
cases.then: Out of order and by the preparer refused; after both levels the journal is Posted with one ledger entry; the rejected one is back with its preparer; the small one needs journals.post and creates no approval request

cases.title: A level that names a permission can be delegated: the delegate acts as the holder of that permission for the dates chosen, and a delegation from someone without the permission gives nothing
cases.given: A rule whose level is the permission to transfer between banks; a holder, a delegate and an outsider
cases.when: A payment above the band is submitted; the delegate and the outsider try to approve before and after the delegations
cases.then: Refused without a delegation or from a delegator who lacks the permission; allowed from the holder, the history names the holder, one voucher posts

cases.title: An invoice posts Dr receivable, Cr revenue and VAT output, the receivable line tagged with the customer
cases.when: An invoice of 1000 + 15% VAT is created
cases.then: Entry: AR 1150 Dr (customer tag), revenue 1000 Cr, VAT 150 Cr

cases.title: An invoice for a customer with a posting profile uses the profile control account and tags
cases.given: A customer with a control account and default dimensions
cases.then: The receivable line is on that account with those tags

cases.title: A credit note reverses revenue and VAT and keeps the customer tag
cases.then: Mirror entry; customer balance falls

cases.title: A paid invoice cannot be cancelled once ZATCA cleared it; a credit note is the only way
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: Cancelling an unpaid invoice reverses its entry on the cancellation date
cases.then: Reversal entry; customer balance zero

cases.title: An invoice with a header discount posts the discounted revenue and correct VAT
cases.then: Revenue and VAT computed after discount

cases.title: An invoice for a stock item also posts cost of goods sold and relieves inventory
cases.given: A stocked item with average cost
cases.then: COGS Dr and inventory Cr at the average cost

cases.title: Invoice payment status moves Unpaid, Partially Paid, Paid with amounts
cases.then: Status and amount_paid follow

cases.title: A payment larger than the outstanding amount on the invoice route is refused
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: A B2B invoice with missing buyer fields is refused for ZATCA; B2C is accepted
cases.given: A B2B customer without VAT number
cases.then: Refused with the missing field named

cases.title: Invoice numbering is gap-free per company and per year rule
cases.then: Numbers continue without reuse

cases.title: A POS sale posts like an invoice and a POS return posts like a credit note
cases.then: Entries mirror each other

cases.title: ZATCA submission runs after the creating transaction commits and never blocks the request
cases.then: Response returns first; status moves SUBMITTING then REPORTED / CLEARED

cases.title: The ZATCA XML of a cleared invoice validates with the SDK (dual gate)
cases.when: fatoora -validate is run on its XML
cases.then: XSD, EN, KSA pass; PIH failure ignorable for a non-genesis invoice

cases.title: The customer list screen shows balances that equal the ledger
cases.then: Balance column equals the party ledger balance

cases.title: An invoice dated outside the open month is refused with the month message
cases.when: Create an invoice dated in it
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: One receipt settles several invoices: one voucher, one ledger entry tagged with the customer, N allocations
cases.then: One voucher, one entry (bank Dr / AR Cr, customer tag), two allocation rows, both invoices Paid

cases.title: A receipt can be read back with its allocations and listed with applied and on-account figures
cases.then: Numbers, party, applied, unapplied are correct

cases.title: A partial allocation keeps the rest on account and the aging shows the credit
cases.given: Invoices 115 and 230; receipt 300 allocating 100 to the first
cases.when: The aging and ledger are read
cases.then: First invoice Partially Paid; 200 on account; customer total 45

cases.title: Money on account can be applied later to open invoices
cases.then: Applied 150, 50 left; invoice Partially Paid

cases.title: Applying more than is held, or more than is owed on a document, is refused
cases.then: Both refused; 15 accepted

cases.title: A receipt of zero, a negative, NaN or an absurd amount is refused
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: Allocations that exceed the receipt amount are refused
cases.then: Refused

cases.title: A document listed twice, a document of another customer, or another company is refused
cases.given: Documents of other parties and companies
cases.then: Each refused; nothing written

cases.title: An inactive or foreign bank is refused
cases.given: An inactive bank, another company bank
